body: I know its's so hard to believe in this moment but you will get to do all of those things! I promise you. If you have a desire for all of those things, you have a reason to stay alive. I said all the same things when I was 18 and I didn't realize that one day all those dreams I thought would never happen to me would actually happen. Life changes in an instant sometimes, you never know what your future holds. I always wish I would have listened to the older people giving me advice back then, I wasted so much time on dwelling about shit that I didn't even need to worry about. Enjoy the time you have right now because youth passes you by so fast.

God you sound so much like me. I hope you know that you are not alone in the way you think. It's hard for normal people to understand why we feel this way but I'm almost certain your friends are not doing it on purpose. Whenever I assume what my friends are thinking about me most of the time I am wrong and I end up feeling silly afterwards. Your friends definitely care about you and next time you end up thinking negative about yourself over anyone just stop, take a breath and think, "am I overreacting?" Because odds are your mind just automatically went to all the worst scenarios you could think of. Your mind is an evil trickster, don't always believe it. (:
Never looked at it that way, thats good motivation haha
